title: teslalog: Charges
description: Closed charging sessions with resolved locations and (if configured) cost.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(charge_energy_added_kwh), 0) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(charge_energy_added_kwh), 0) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(max_charger_power_kw), 0) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(max_charger_power_kw), 0) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  start_time AS time,
  COALESCE(location, printf('%.4f, %.4f', latitude, longitude)) AS "Location",
  start_battery_level AS "% start",
  end_battery_level AS "% end",
  ROUND(charge_energy_added_kwh, 1) AS "kWh added",
  ROUND(charge_energy_used_kwh, 1) AS "kWh used (est.)",
  ROUND(max_charger_power_kw, 1) AS "max kW",
  ROUND(cost, 2) AS "cost",
  ROUND((julianday(end_time) - julianday(start_time)) * 24 * 60, 0) AS "min"
FROM charging_sessions
WHERE status = 'closed'
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 500
